entries.title: Pricing Discussion - Acme Corp
entries.subject: Re: Q3 Pricing Proposal
entries.snippet: Hi Team, Following our discussion about the Q3 pricing for the expanded service agreement, I wanted to confirm that the volume discount structure works for us...
entries.notes:
Good example of how to structure volume discounts for large clients.

The wording around payment terms (NET-30 with 2% early payment discount) was well received by the client. They specifically called out the tiered pricing table as clear and easy to understand.

Key takeaway: present discount tiers as percentages alongside dollar amounts.

entries.title: Objection Handling - Budget Constraints
entries.snippet: When a client says their budget is locked, try reframing the conversation around ROI and total cost of ownership...
entries.notes:
When a client says their budget is locked, try reframing the conversation around ROI and total cost of ownership rather than unit price.

Effective phrases:
- "I understand budget constraints. Let me show you how this pays for itself within [timeframe]."
- "What if we structured this so the savings offset the investment within the first quarter?"
- "Many of our clients in similar positions found that the productivity gains alone covered the cost."

Avoid: directly challenging their budget figure or suggesting they "find" more budget.
